entries.final_answer: Charter generate/interview --json (and the sibling text output plus _display_path()) report repository-relative paths with the host separator, so a Windows consumer reads .kittify\\charter\\charter.md where Linux and macOS read .kittify/charter/charter.md. Same defect #6277 fixed for charter synthesize; follow-up tracked as issue #7044.
entries.question: What problem does this Mission solve?

entries.final_answer: Under a Windows path-rendering simulation both envelopes (charter_path, interview_path), the Charter:/Interview file: text lines, the missing/malformed-interview error and _display_path() report zero backslashes and the same .kittify/... strings POSIX reports; the out-of-repo fallback still returns a path and pre-existing POSIX expectations pass unchanged. See SC-001..SC-004.
entries.question: How will we know this Mission is successful?

entries.final_answer: Out of scope: the charter synthesize reporting surface and the committed synthesis-manifest.yaml (issue #6277 / PR #7045), any envelope schema, field-name, ordering or exit-code change, and any hand-rolled separator swap or a second copy of the helper in the CLI layer (C-001, C-002, C-003).
